author: SpecCraft
body:
• Your minecraft username(most recent name if changed): SpecCraft
  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned: I was banned because I was fly hacking.
  • Why you should be unbanned from the server.: I feel that I should be unbanned because I've been on Avicus a long time. I'm not like most people who have been banned for hacking as I spent quite most time on the server roughly, 22 hours then as soon as I was banned I realized I made a dumb decision because Avicus was my FAVORITE server. I didn't know what to do, I was very bored on minecraft so i took a long break, so long I even forgot I had an account then somewhere around last week I came on avicus was the first server on my multiplayer server list so I tried it and I was banned. So I thought I can have a second chance then this is how I got to do this.Now I'm asking for a second chance and I vow to not hack on avicus network.
  • Thanks for reading, -SpecCraft

title: Infraction Appeal

replies.author: chaibrit1
replies.body:
Hi,

Thank you for sending in an appeal. Considering you have been banned for some time now and that you do seem to regret hacking, I have decided to appeal your ban. If you are caught hacking once again though, your chances of being appealed will be very low. Welcome back.

Regards,

GalaxyBrit
Avicus Network Senior Moderator
